name: dungeon
description: Adventure sites, ruins, lairs, and hostile complexes

entries.value: Buried Temple — collapsed sacred chambers surrounding a sealed altar that still receives offerings.
Abandoned Mine — unstable galleries, flooded shafts, old equipment, and something following the rails.
Bandit Cavern — natural tunnels expanded with barricades, storerooms, cells, and hidden exits.
Ruined Fortress — broken walls above intact arsenals, command tunnels, and forgotten defenders.
Ancient Crypt — family tombs, funerary traps, ancestral records, and disturbed sealed chambers.
Wizard's Tower — stacked laboratories where failed experiments have altered gravity and space.
Sewer Labyrinth — active drains, forgotten foundations, smuggler routes, and territorial creatures.
Sunken Palace — flooded halls accessible during low tide, through diving, or by ancient pumps.
Monster Warren — interconnected nests shaped by generations of increasingly large inhabitants.
Prison Complex — cells, workshops, execution rooms, guard passages, and evidence of a mass escape.
Collapsed City District — buried streets and homes connected through basements and sinkholes.
Cursed Manor — a noble residence repeating the final night before its household's destruction.
Volcanic Shrine — heat-blasted tunnels, sacrificial bridges, lava channels, and fireproof guardians.
Frozen Tomb — ice-preserved halls where opening doors releases ancient air, disease, and occupants.
Cult Sanctuary — disguised meeting rooms descending into ritual chambers and an unfinished summoning site.
Living Dungeon — an enormous organism whose chambers digest intruders and rearrange like organs.
Dream Prison — a mental complex entered through sleep, with exits hidden in prisoners' memories.
Inverted Tower — a structure descending into the earth while gravity points toward its distant roof.
Planar Embassy — an abandoned diplomatic complex built for visitors with incompatible bodies and physics.
Clockwork Vault — precise mechanical rooms that reset traps and rotate corridors on a fixed schedule.
Worldroot Hollow — primeval tunnels inside a colossal root system infected by a spreading corruption.
Astral Observatory — a remote ruin whose lenses open physical paths toward dangerous celestial objects.
